annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.every: About every 7,500 miles on the factory schedule; sooner with lots of short trips
maint.note: YourMechanic averages about $159 for a Lumina oil change.

maint.every: Inspect every 10,000 miles; replace when the pads wear to about 2 mm
maint.note: YourMechanic puts pads at about $200 to $500 per axle; rotors cost extra.

maint.every: About every 2 front brake jobs; check at each brake inspection
maint.note: RepairPal estimates $325 to $411. Most Luminas of these years use rear drum brakes.

maint.every: Follow the owner's manual; YourMechanic's Lumina schedule lists plugs at 30,000-mile steps
maint.note: The rear plugs on the V6 sit against the firewall, which adds labor.

maint.every: About every 40,000–50,000 miles, or as the owner's manual says
